THE BIG ONE from this pass: the phone save bar inherited top:2px from the desktop rule, so position:fixed + top + bottom stretched it into an invisible full-page tap shield - display name, change email, everything above the fold was untappable on phones. top:auto. Found because the change-email capture refused to click; desktop e2e could never see it.

No auth error was a live region - wrong-password/reset/change-email/propose failures were silent to screen readers. role=alert across all five. (The skeptic mis-refuted this one; the fix is a one-liner and the finding was right.)
The change-email toggle had a ~17px tap target - covered by the inline text-button hit-area rule.
A dead game link showed 'no game here yet.' and nothing else - now it explains and offers the games-near-you list.

Three findings wanted 15px prose raised to 16px (landing pages, 404, auth labels). Declined: the 16px floor is the iOS input-zoom rule, not a prose rule - inputs are already floored on touch, and 15px body text here is deliberate hierarchy. The skeptic killed the equivalent claims for the same reason.
Capture tooling: the landscape-splash shot was taken in portrait (missing viewport arg) - fixed and recaptured; the splash holds up in landscape.
